preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain owner privileges) to call includeInReward()
At least two addresses must be in the _excluded array
The address to be included (account) must be in the _excluded array

exploit_hint: As owner, call includeInReward() on an excluded address that is not the last in the _excluded array. This will swap it with the last address but fail to update the mapping for the swapped address, causing _excludedAddressToId[lastAddress] to remain at its old position while that address moves to a new index. This corrupts the mapping and can cause issues in _getCurrentSupply() calculations, potentially leading to incorrect reflection balances.
